name: Dynamic Cables Ltd
tagline: Rajasthan power-cable maker (HV/LV/EHV up to 220kV plus conductors) riding the power-transmission and solar capex super-cycle - ~27% ROCE, de-levered, real-time RM pass-through, UL and PGCIL approvals opening the US and PGCIL - held back only by a promoter-related corporate guarantee and capex-timing slippage
business_overview: Dynamic Cables manufactures power cables (HV ~55% of revenue, LV ~37%) and aluminium conductors (~8%), serving power utilities (~70% of the order book), solar/renewables (~15%), and government discoms, with a growing export book (~10% target). Promoter Mr Mangaal has been steadily buying; the company added its first analyst concalls in FY24-25. It holds RDSO/utility approvals, and in FY26 secured UL 854 certification (US market entry) and PGCIL approval for ACSR / AL59 conductors from its Reengus plant.

Revenue ~Rs 349 Cr (+33% YoY), OPM ~11%, PAT ~Rs 25 Cr (+37% YoY)
OPM 9% -> 10% -> 10% -> 11% FY23-26 and steady ~11% across the last 6 quarters through metal-price volatility

fundamentals_narrative: A clean small-cap converter aligned to India's power-transmission and solar capex cycle: revenue Rs 669 -> 768 -> 1,025 -> 1,198 Cr FY23-26, PAT Rs 31 -> 84 Cr, and -- the key deep-dive confirmation -- OPM held 9% -> 10% -> 10% -> 11% and has stayed steady at ~11% across the last six quarters despite copper/aluminium volatility, which validates management's real-time two-way RM pass-through claim in practice. ROCE ~26%, ROE ~20%, long-term debt largely repaid (gross borrowings ~Rs 43 Cr, net adj leverage 0.68x). Q1 FY27 revenue +33% YoY / PAT +37% -- delivery has run ~30% for six straight quarters against a conservative 18-20% guidance. The greenfield is on a dated schedule (trial Sep 2026, commercial Q4 FY27, 80-85% utilisation by end-FY28) but is small in capex terms (~Rs 45 Cr, ~Rs 270 Cr revenue potential at a 6x asset turn); the 'toward ~Rs 1,600 Cr full capacity' figure needs the debottlenecked base plus the greenfield at full utilisation, a multi-year story. US exports have genuinely started (13% of Q1 revenue via a distribution-led model) and PGCIL ACSR/AL-59 approval is in hand. Offsets: margins are structurally thin (~11%, converter economics -- the 10x is a volume/multiple story, not a margin story); the ~Rs 344 Cr Indokrates related-party corporate guarantee stands; and promoter holding has slipped ~6pp over 15 months (74.5% -> 68.2%) for a reason this pass could not verify (0% pledge, no FY26 encumbrance).
technical_read: Not independently pulled; stock corrected meaningfully over ~6 months on capex delays and a weak quarter before stabilising - forum posters see EPS of ~Rs 22-23 with a conservative 20x+ multiple as the near-term anchor.
sentiment_summary: Active 42-post thread since 2022. The founding post (blue, 13 loves) framed it as a 'damn cheap' capex-boom proxy. First_Principles contributed two well-received sector deep-dives (14-18 loves) on the 20 listed cable companies and the RM-dependency / thin-GPM risk - later updated by Santosh_Sinha and management's own concall confirmation that RM cost is fully passed through. kartik_bhat, Jitendrapd94 and Tushar_Gupta1 (elevated tier) have posted detailed, positive concall notes across FY25-26 (highest-ever revenue, order book growing QoQ, debt repaid, US/PGCIL approvals). The two recurring cautions: the ~Rs 344 Cr Indokrates related-party corporate guarantee (Bibin_ponnachan raised it; prabal_jain researched and found it 'doesn't seem like a problem') and the capex-commissioning timeline slippage.
community_signal: Three elevated-tier users (kartik_bhat, Jitendrapd94, Tushar_Gupta1) have independently posted constructive, detailed concall coverage and at least one (Jitendrapd94) discloses being invested - a consistent positive community read, though none has framed it as a sized high-conviction call.

trusted_signals.note: Posted detailed Q2 FY26 and Q3 FY26 result + concall notes: order book ~Rs 721 Cr, long-term borrowings fully repaid, greenfield (6x asset turn) to take full capacity to ~Rs 1,600 Cr by H2 FY26/FY27, solar cables 10-15% of revenue with a Rs 6,000-7,000 Cr TAM. Factual/positive coverage from an elevated-tier user; elevated not core, no conviction floor active.

Summarised the Q3 FY25 concall (highest-ever Q3/9M revenue, 9M sales +32%, PAT +72%, meaningful debt reduction, order book Rs 682 Cr, ~10.3% margins in line with long-term guidance); disclosed as invested. Elevated tier, no floor.
